title: Umutima uri maso ku nkengera y'uruzi
intro: Umutima mutoyi warajejwe igikorwa c’ibanga, co kwihweza ari kure cane ingene iherezo ryariko rigenda ku mazi. Ico kigereranyo kitabonetse kandi kitakekwa, cogira uruhara runini mu guhindura ingendo y’amateka y’igihugu.
clues: Narahawe igikorwa na mawe, igikorwa cari gisaba kwiba no kuba maso.
Amaso yanje yakurikiye akazu gatoyi kariko karagendagenda ku mugezi, umutima wanje uremerewe n'amaganya.
Igihe ryaboneka n’umugwi utari witeze, narayegereye, mfise ubwoba bwinshi.
Nabonye ukuntu bihebuye kubera uwuzobabungabunga maze ndababwira umuti ntavuze ukuri.
Ugufasha kwanje ku gihe kwatumye umutima wonsa usubira ku wuwukeneye cane.
Mu ngoro z’abakomeye, naravuze nti: ‘None ndabayobore mu muryango uzomugaburira kandi uzomurera neza?’.

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yaciye asubira guhura n'uwo mwana na nyina wiwe .
outcome.answer: Yaciye asubira guhura n'uwo mwana na nyina wiwe .

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
